idea-plugin.name: Hardcoded Credential Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Open any config file and see every hardcoded credential — and every setting that quietly undoes your encryption — with the line number and the reason. 30 checks, 30 safe-config snippets, offline in the editor, no account.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Hardcoded Credential Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 30 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/hardcoded-credential-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com

action.text: Hardcoded Credential Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Hardcoded Credential Audit on the file in the editor
